title: Ending Predator Access to Union Power Act
short_title: Ending Predator Access to Union Power Act
committees: H-Education and Workforce Committee: Referred To 2026-05-12 -> Markup By 2026-07-21
committee_votes: Education and Workforce Committee 2026-07-21: Ordered reported - 33-0
summary: Ending Predator Access to Union Power Act This bill prohibits an individual convicted of a sex offense against a minor from serving in a leadership position for a labor organization, as a consultant or advisor to a labor organization, or as an employer labor consultant or representative in collective bargaining for 13 years after the conviction or imprisonment for the offense. Current law prohibits an individual from serving in these types of roles for 13 years after a conviction or imprisonment for specific crimes (including robbery, bribery, burglary, murder, or rape). The bill includes a sex offense against a minor as one of the specified crimes.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
